The OSI model has 7 layers and is a conceptual framework, while the TCP/IP model has 4 layers and is used in real-world networking.
TCP/IP combines some OSI layers and focuses on practical implementation.

UDP is used in real-time applications like video streaming or online gaming.
It is preferred because low latency is more important than reliabilty.
